component.name: Swamp Swap
component.summary: A user interface for the file transfer program croc

description.p: Swamp Swap is a user interface wrapped around a command line file transfer utility called croc. croc provides simple and private file transfers between two users, and Swamp Swap provides a fun, handy user interface to operate it from. croc was created by Zack Schollz.
